root_causes: The original BG169 terminal guard returned TERMINAL_MERGE_ADMITTED after full Required+CodeQL and backend success, but its final GitHub API requested merge_method=merge while the provider allows only squashMergeAllowed=true.

The original postmerge verification falsely required exact candidate-head commit ancestry on protected main. Squash produces a new commit: exact candidate/merged Git tree equivalence plus provider merge-commit SHA must be verified instead.
fix: In the SAME original Unified Brain Delivery BG169 terminal workflow check repository allow_squash_merge via GitHub provider before irreversible commit, and request the allowed squash method only.

Check exact provider returned merge sha, its ancestry in protected main, accepted PR merged identity/merge_commit_sha and exact tested source tree equality for squash. Preserve existing exact HEAD branch and main CAS, admission, CodeQL, Required and role boundaries.
prevention: Never make a release transport assume a GitHub merge method different from repository permissions.
A squash release must preserve exact tested tree identity, not falsely infer source-head ancestry.
Mark no terminal / publication outcome from failure, PR creation, scheduler ACK, or provider HTTP response without independent readback.

evidence.initial_native_failure: gh: Merge commits are not allowed on this repository (HTTP 405)
